title: Replaying a word onto the output
statement: For every pair of Boolean words $x,a$ and every natural number $i\le |x|$, for each natural number $j\le |a|$, the raw strip machine started in state $3$ on input $x$, with work tape containing $a$, work head at position $0$, and empty output, is after $j$ steps in state $3$, with work head at position $j$ and output equal to the prefix of $a$ of length $j$.
